title: nf-core/cbmdiscovery pipeline parameters
description: Reference-free discovery and characterization of Programmed DNA Elimination Chromosome Breakage Motifs from raw sequencing reads

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with header 'sample,platform,reads_1,reads_2'. See usage docs.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

cbm_discovery_options.title: CBM discovery options
cbm_discovery_options.description: Parameters for reference-free CBM and PDE junction discovery.

min_germ_reads.description: Minimum germline read-through reads required to reconstruct a germline branch.

min_telo_reads.description: Minimum telomeric reads required to support somatic cleavage branch.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to the output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.
